command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$nodes=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_02/nodes' -Method Get); foreach(`$n in `$nodes){ `$u='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_02/nodes/'+`$n.node_id+'/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration'; `$v='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork-for-perf_02/nodes/'+`$n.node_id+'/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration'; `$a=((Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u -Method Get).output -split '\r?\n'); `$b=((Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$v -Method Get).output -split '\r?\n'); `$d=Compare-Object -ReferenceObject `$b -DifferenceObject `$a | Where-Object { `$_.InputObject -notmatch '^(!Last|#|return$|Error:)' }; if(`$d){ '=== '+`$n.name; `$d | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 240 } }"
